annotations.title: Settle the look and its colours

description: Settles the look and colours of the video once they've chosen (or once you've chosen, in make it for me), remembers them for their next videos, and returns the look written out in those colours, with a colour of their own kept readable. Call it before the art stage and before drawing any picture.

look.description: The look's id (their own looks start with my-)

palette.description: A palette's id or name, or one colour of their own as #RRGGBB. Leave out to use what they chose last for this look, or else its own colours

series.description: The series this video belongs to, if any: the choice is kept for it too
